einzeiler: A deep dive into the new Hobbit set for Magic: The Gathering, highlighting cards and…
kurzfassung: The hosts review the upcoming Hobbit set for Magic: The Gathering, discussing collecting options and product configurations. They highlight notable new mechanics like storied, recruit, and hone. Finally, they share their favorite cards from the set and how they fit into Commander decks.
stichpunkte: Fusion Gaming Online sponsors the episode with the promo code CCO Nation for a discount on products.
The hosts criticize changes to two-headed giant pre-release kits, reducing the number of packs per team.
Collecting options include play boosters, collector boosters, bundles, and scene boxes with unique book-cover treatments.
New set mechanics introduced are storied, recruit, hone, and updated amass rules.
Balin, Master of Laketown, and other standout cards are highlighted for specific Commander synergies.
Reprints like Orcish Bowmasters and Galadriel, Light of Valinor return with new artwork.
